sections.heading: Appointment
paragraphs: The Board appointed Meera Rao as India-based Data Protection Officer effective 2026-04-01. She reports to the Board risk committee and has authority to request business records.
The privacy office has 1.5 FTE for rights operations, notice delivery and processing reviews. Security operations and the SOC retain their separate staffing.

sections.heading: Accountability
paragraphs: The DPO signs quarterly grievance reports and consults on consent changes. The predecessor was the legal operations manager until 2026-03-31.
